title: Daynori Web/PWA Visual Polish and Usability Refinement

targetedAreasRefined.refinement: Modernized Card with calm variant and softer borders; de-boxified EmptyState with circular action badges and warm notebook cards; refined Dialog backdrop blur and sheet radius; refined CreationMenu with >= 48px touch targets and icon badge borders.
